user.title: Bentel Absoluta
user.description: Connect to the Absoluta panel through the ABS-IP plug-in (ITv2 protocol over TCP). The ITv2 session is closed by the panel whenever BOSS or the mobile app connects; the integration reconnects automatically.

data_description.host: IP address of the ABS-IP plug-in
data_description.pin: PIN of a Master, Normal or Limited user (1-6 digits). Only the partitions, zones and outputs of this user are exposed.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the user PIN
reauth_confirm.description: The panel rejected the stored PIN. Enter a valid user PIN.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the panel. Check IP/port, that the ITv2 protocol is enabled on the ABS-IP and that no other ITv2 client is connected.
error.invalid_pin: The PIN must be 1 to 6 digits.

data.require_code: Require the code to arm/disarm from Home Assistant

data_description.poll_interval: Zone open/closed state is not pushed by the panel and is polled at this interval (it also works as keep-alive).
data_description.require_code: When enabled the alarm panel entities ask for the user PIN and the arming-mode buttons are not created.
